subject: Acceptance cord — SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA scope confirmation (ClearCredit MAP)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Liu <susan.liu@clearcredit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Apr 9, 2027 at 08:14 AM -0700
Subject: Acceptance cord — SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA scope confirmation (ClearCredit MAP)

Hi Susan —

Following our demo and the MAP template, attached are two docs to start the security acceptance conversation: a proposed SOC 2 scope (clearcredit_soc2_scope_v1.pdf) and our initial DPA redlines (proposed_dpa_redlines.docx). High-level asks from our side to close the MAP: 

- SOC 2: target attestation level and expected date (Type II preferred) required to meet the MAP acceptance gate.
- SIG/CAIQ: current completion status and any outstanding high/critical responses.
- DPA: confirm the few redline items we flagged (data deletion SLA, subprocessors list, and incident notification windows).
- Data retention: final retention windows for customer PII, telemetry/logs, and backups (we suggested defaults in the SOC 2 scope doc).

Proposed acceptance cord (what we agree to as MAP completion criteria):
1) SOC 2 report (or auditor letter) covering relevant control categories OR a SOC 2 timeline that commits to report within 60 days after go-live;
2) Completed SIG/CAIQ with any high/critical mitigations documented;
3) Signed DPA with agreed retention windows;
4) A short remediation/monitoring plan for any open items with owners and dates.

If this alignment looks good, can we lock a 30-minute sync next week to confirm dates? My suggested slot: Tue 2027-04-13 10:00–10:30 PT.

Thanks — I’m happy to adjust language in the DPA and map specific controls to the SOC scope once you share the SIG/CAIQ status.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: clearcredit_soc2_scope_v1.pdf, proposed_dpa_redlines.docx

From: Susan Liu <susan.liu@clearcredit.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearcredit.com
Date: Fri, Apr 9, 2027 at 11:02 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance cord — SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA scope confirmation (ClearCredit MAP)

Alex —

Thanks for the clear summary and the docs. Quick responses from our side: 

- SOC 2: ClearCredit is mid-cycle for our Type II audit; expected final report window is early Q3 2027. We can share an auditor engagement letter and the controls we’ll include by end of next week. That should meet your acceptance cord if Redwood can accept a committed report date (we understand you prefer an in-hand report).

- SIG/CAIQ: we have a partial CAIQ completed (about 70%). I uploaded the draft responses to the Drive link below and our security team will finish high/critical responses by Apr 16.

- DPA: we reviewed the redlines. A few engineering items (data deletion API semantics, proof of deletion) need technical clarification — happy to take a short session with your infra/ops engineer.

- Retention: current ClearCredit defaults are: PII retention 7 years (subject to legal hold), telemetry/aggregated logs 13 months, backups 90 days. We can consider shorter retention for sandbox/test environments.

We’re ok with the MAP acceptance cord as long as the plan includes the auditor letter plus final report by Q3 if any controls are pending. We can join the Tue 10:00 PT slot — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C

—Susan Liu
Head of Security, ClearCredit
susan.liu@clearcredit.com
(212) 555-0199

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, Apr 10, 2027 at 09:28 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance cord — SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA scope confirmation (ClearCredit MAP)

Internal notes / ask for the call: 

Alex / Neha — good catch on the acceptance cord. A couple of legal/compliance points we should confirm before the sync with ClearCredit: 

- Retention tiers: propose we offer the following options in the SOW/DPA: (A) default (PII 7 years / logs 13 months / backups 90 days), (B) reduced retention (PII 2 years / logs 13 months / backups 90 days) for customers that request it, and (C) EU residency option if requested (separate appendix). Please confirm product/ops feasibility on per-customer retention toggles.

- Incident notification: tighten to 72 hours for confirmed breaches; Redwood standard is 72 hours with escalation path — keep that in the DPA redlines.

- SIG/CAIQ: ask security to produce a short list of any high or critical open responses so we can decide if they block acceptance or are acceptable with mitigations. If they are process gaps (e.g., missing vendor reviews), we can require documented remediation steps and owners in the MAP.

I’ll prepare redline language for the retention appendix and a short one-pager for the MAP acceptance criteria we can share in the call.

—Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Liu <susan.liu@clearcredit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 03:42 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance cord — SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA scope confirmation (ClearCredit MAP)

Thanks everyone — great alignment. Recap and next steps so we have a single MAP artifact after the call: 

MAP commitment (agreed acceptance cord):
- SOC 2: auditor engagement letter shared by Apr 16, final Type II report no later than Aug 15, 2027 OR auditor letter + remediation schedule if any high-controls remain.
- SIG/CAIQ: ClearCredit to complete high/critical responses by Apr 16; security to supply a one-page summary of any remaining gaps.
- DPA: Redwood to push updated redlines (language from Kimberly on retention appendix + 72-hour incident notification) by Apr 14. ClearCredit legal to review and return signed copy within 10 business days of receipt.
- Retention: default retention tiers accepted (PII 7y / logs 13m / backups 90d) with option B (reduced retention) available via SOW appendix. EU residency will be a separate appendix if requested.

Owners and tentative dates:
- ClearCredit security (Susan) — CAIQ final + auditor letter by Apr 16 (owner)
- Redwood legal (Kimberly) — updated DPA redlines by Apr 14 (owner)
- Redwood product/ops (Neha) — confirm per-customer retention feasibility by Apr 14 (owner)
- Alex — coordinate MAP artifact, send consolidated MAP doc and schedule go/no-go checkpoint for Apr 23.

Call info: Tue Apr 13, 2027, 10:00–10:30 PT — Zoom link will be in the invite.

Attachments included in the MAP email thread: clearcredit_soc2_scope_v1.pdf, proposed_dpa_redlines.docx

If there are no objections I’ll produce the consolidated MAP artifact after the call and attach it to the HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567890

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
